illustrationSummary: Halyk uses compact polished 3D objects in banners and empty states to distinguish services and soften administrative tasks.

name: Brilliant
uiSummary: A bright interactive-learning interface with white space, heavy black hierarchy, vivid blue or green lesson actions, soft-gray containers, and compact 3D diagrams. Progress is expressed through short checks, skill paths, manipulable visual models, and immediate explanations rather than long reading.
uxSummary: Brilliant structures learning as short interactive challenges with immediate explanation, visible progress, and a clear next skill.
navigationSummary: Home recommends the next lesson; Courses exposes the catalog; You contains profile and settings. Active lessons use only close, progress, sound, energy, and the current task.
illustrationSummary: Illustration is an interactive teaching model, not decoration. It turns abstract math, science, logic, and code into objects the learner can inspect or manipulate.

name: GO Club
uiSummary: A vivid habit and fitness dashboard built from electric cobalt gradients, translucent blue layers, oversized black metrics, white pill controls, and sharp lemon-to-mint progress accents. Large graphic cards turn steps, water, plans, and countdowns into bold daily rituals.
uxSummary: GO Club turns steps, water, plans, goals, and daily completion into focused habit dashboards with lightweight history and customization.
navigationSummary: Primary navigation switches between the few primary habit areas. Each destination keeps one current metric and its main control available.
coreFlows: Log water and follow a plan
illustrationSummary: GO Club uses bold graphic objects and compact line-art scenes as motivational companions to metrics and plans.

name: Arc Search
uiSummary: A soft spatial browser interface built from luminous lavender-pink backgrounds, frosted white page cards, cobalt AI headings, and a thumb-centered bottom dock. Search, tabs, and page tools appear as layered sheets while live web content remains recognizable behind them.
uxSummary: Arc Search is a mobile browser focused on universal search, AI-generated Browse for Me summaries, tab switching, page tools, and concise settings. Browser controls remain available during browsing.
navigationSummary: Primary navigation exposes tab overview, new search, and page or menu controls. Search opens modally, and tabs remain directly selectable.

name: ATTO
uiSummary: A bright transit super-app that combines a teal-to-blue shell, white rounded content sheets, high-saturation action tiles, map surfaces, and polished 3D transport objects. Payment cards and route maps anchor the signed-in experience; friendly rendered buses, trains, tickets, and city services make onboarding and the service hub immediately legible.
uxSummary: ATTO joins city services, transport cards, trip planning, and fare payment. The signed-out hub advertises breadth; the signed-in transport workspace prioritizes balance and the next payment action.
navigationSummary: The service hub opens from a hamburger and support header. Transport uses Main, Trip history, Transport, and Menu. Routes and metro become focused map workspaces with back, mode, and zoom controls.
illustrationSummary: Use illustration to make transport and city services recognizable before reading. It supports onboarding and service discovery, not transactional forms.

name: Bereke
uiSummary: A bright retail-banking interface that combines clean white cards, pale cool-gray canvases, saturated green actions, and electric-blue highlights. Dense money tasks stay legible through large totals, compact shortcuts, and rounded grouped lists, while polished 3D objects distinguish promotional products.
uxSummary: Bereke organizes accounts, cards, transfers, payments, and services around a scannable home dashboard. Transactional tasks are short, linear, and confirmation-led.
navigationSummary: Primary navigation connects primary areas. Product detail and money movement provides an explicit back action.
illustrationSummary: Illustration differentiates product discovery from routine banking and makes abstract offers feel tangible.

name: WB Bank
uiSummary: A dense ecosystem bank mixing Wildberries hot magenta, dark green wallet panels, pale lilac canvas, white service tiles, bold black financial typography, and glossy 3D product art. The home screen behaves like a modular marketplace dashboard, while transfers and applications simplify into bright linear forms with one charcoal confirmation action.
uxSummary: WB Bank embeds a broad bank inside the Wildberries ecosystem: wallet, cards, payments, savings, credit, cashback, and support share one dense service home.
navigationSummary: - The marketplace primary navigation remains visible, with the Bank destination highlighted in magenta. - Bank Home combines discount status, wallet balance, quick actions, promotion rail, and a product catalog. - Transfers, cards, savings, and settings branch into focused detail flows with local back navigation.
illustrationSummary: WB Bank uses glossy 3D banking objects and product miniatures to distinguish offers inside a dense financial dashboard.

name: Suno
uiSummary: A dark AI-music product built from near-black chrome, translucent charcoal creation panels, artwork-derived gradients, white rounded playback controls, and a hot pink-to-orange creative accent. Dense social music feeds coexist with a focused studio form and persistent mini-player.
uxSummary: Suno combines AI song creation, social music discovery, playback, library management, publishing, and profile tools.
navigationSummary: - Five primary destinations cover Home, Explore, Create, Library, and Profile. - Create remains a primary destination in the global navigation. - A mini-player remains from the current task while audio is active.

name: SberBank Online
uiSummary: A broad financial super-app built on misty mint gradients, white rounded modules, strong black hierarchy, and focused Sber green actions. Dense banking information is split into configurable cards, while friendly pastel 3D financial objects add identity to services without obscuring balances or transactions.
uxSummary: SberBank Online organizes everyday balances, cards, transfers, payments, savings, loans, security, services, and assistant help as configurable dashboard modules and focused task flows.
navigationSummary: - The five primary destinations separates Home, Savings, Lifestyle, Payments, and Loans. - Wallet and History provide cross-product views from Home. - Search with GigaChat and profile remain available in the current context of primary areas.
illustrationSummary: SberBank Online uses soft pastel 3D objects to identify financial products and service categories. The objects support navigation and promotion while balances, transactions, and forms remain illustration-free.

name: Kompanion
uiSummary: A pale blue-white retail banking interface centered on saturated royal-blue cards and actions, rounded white service tiles, colorful circular story badges, soft promotional banners, and a prominent QR tab. Financial screens are orderly and spacious, with blue line icons and green confirmation states.
uxSummary: Kompanion is a retail banking app for cards, wallets, payments, transfers, savings, loans, deposits, currency exchange, cashback, and service management.
navigationSummary: Five primary destinations cover Home, Payments, QR, History, and Menu. Home prioritizes cards and frequent transfers; search and notifications remain in the discovery context.

name: ForteApp
uiSummary: A broad mobile bank using a coral-to-magenta identity gradient, burgundy primary actions, white product panels, thin rose line icons, cyan informational cards, compact account tabs, dense financial rows, and a five-tab shell for chat, history, home, transfers, and payments.
uxSummary: ForteApp joins banking products, cards, transfers, payments, forex, services, documents, history, and support.
navigationSummary: Chats, History, Home, Transfers, and Payments remain stable; product tabs organize cards, loans, deposits, and accounts.

name: Jomo
uiSummary: An optimistic digital-wellbeing interface that pairs a white utility layer with immersive blue-sky photography, airy blue gradients, oversized rounded sheets, black pill actions, and a friendly app-shaped mascot. Data, blocking controls, and system permissions remain clear while the visual language feels restorative rather than punitive.
uxSummary: Jomo turns screen-time reduction into a guided routine: set a goal, configure app blocking, then review daily usage and reusable rules.
navigationSummary: Four primary destinations cover Home, Rules, Squads, and Profile. The main Start blocking action is repeated from the primary navigation.
illustrationSummary: Jomo uses a cheerful blue app-shaped mascot and small nature scenes to soften digital-wellbeing and restriction tasks.

name: TradingView
uiSummary: A professional dark market interface built from black canvases, fine graphite dividers, compact white data typography, teal and coral price movement, and tool-dense charts. The aesthetic is precise, utilitarian, and optimized for continuous monitoring.
uxSummary: TradingView is a market-monitoring and charting workspace organized around watchlists, interactive charts, discovery, community ideas, and account tools.
navigationSummary: - A five primary destinations covers Watchlist, Chart, Explore, Community, and Menu. - Top actions add symbols, change lists, open menus, and expose account or messaging controls.

name: Booking
uiSummary: A dense, utility-first travel marketplace organized around a royal-blue header, bright-blue actions, yellow focus frames, white information cards, green deal signals, and destination photography. Search parameters, comparison data, policies, and totals remain explicit through every travel category.
uxSummary: Booking supports a broad travel funnel while keeping each category search-first and comparison-led.
navigationSummary: Search, Saved, Bookings, and My account are stable. Stays, Flights, Car rental, Taxi, and Attractions share the Search branch.

name: Russian Post
uiSummary: A service-dense utility interface built on a cool light-gray canvas, white rounded groups, and clear postal blue actions. Compact lists coexist with bright promotional tiles and a consistent family of soft 3D parcel, vehicle, and courier illustrations.
uxSummary: Russian Post brings tracking, sending, pickup, office search, queue booking, help, jobs, bonuses, and profile settings into one utility-oriented app.
navigationSummary: - Five primary destinations separate the main service areas. - Home exposes tracking, office, sending, courier, and account shortcuts. - Deep operational tasks use a linear stack with back navigation and a persistent confirmation action.
illustrationSummary: Russian Post uses friendly 3D service objects to explain delivery products and soften dense utility screens. The illustration language is functional: parcels, vehicles, couriers, buildings, and small tools represent a concrete service rather than decorating empty space.

name: Craft
uiSummary: A calm document workspace on a misty white-gray canvas with soft translucent chrome, black typography, pale cyan selection, rounded floating navigation, miniature document previews, sparse line icons, and a small multicolor assistant accent. Content stays dominant while organization and creation controls hover lightly around it.
uxSummary: Craft organizes documents, folders, tasks, calendar, reminders, publishing, and assistant features around a content-first workspace.
navigationSummary: bottom controls switch between Home, Tasks, and Calendar while separate assistant and create actions remain immediately available. Document views use back, share, and overflow.

name: Click SuperApp
uiSummary: A bright finance super-app built on an ice-blue canvas, white rounded service tiles, saturated azure actions, dense promotional banners, compact icon grids, and a persistent five-item tab bar. Financial values stay prominent while payments, transfers, mini apps, and location services remain one tap away.
uxSummary: Click SuperApp organizes finance and adjacent services around a configurable home dashboard, a wallet model, and stable task navigation.
navigationSummary: The five-primary navigation exposes Home, Payments, Transfers, Reports, and Mini Apps. Contextual detail screens use back navigation; the home search and QR entry points remain globally available.

name: Open
uiSummary: A cinematic wellbeing system built on pure black, full-bleed warm photography, widely spaced white type, hairline geometry, tiny red signals, and sparse outlined or white pill actions.
uxSummary: Open is an immersive breathwork, meditation, movement, and sound experience built around a daily practice, programs, discovery, community, studio tools, and profile progress.
navigationSummary: Primary navigation connects a global context, Discover, practice or waveform, a location-like community destination, and Profile. Today combines the daily practice with Meditate, Breathe, Move, and Sound modes.

name: Tolan
uiSummary: An immersive AI-companion interface built around a softly rendered alien world, deep indigo skies, expressive 3D character animation, cream utility surfaces, and compact pill controls. The UI feels intimate, playful, and gently game-like.
uxSummary: Tolan turns an AI companion into a persistent character living on a small planet. Conversation, daily wellbeing activities, journaling, customization, and progression all return to that shared world.
navigationSummary: - A left drawer opens Journal, Intentions, Insights, Check-ins, Library, Family, Shop, character, planet, and settings. - Contextual entry actions launch affirmations, questions, sessions, and suggested conversations.
illustrationSummary: The reviewed source uses imagery in the product roles documented below.

name: Amie
uiSummary: A radically sparse productivity workspace that stacks a white calendar pane over a white todo pane, joined by a black navigation strip. Fine gray grid lines, restrained pink selection, and soft event pastels create hierarchy without conventional tab chrome.
uxSummary: Amie combines calendar and todos in a vertically split workspace. The schedule stays above, task lists stay below, and One control provides navigation, search, resizing, and creation.
navigationSummary: Calendar and todo surfaces coexist rather than living in separate tabs. A shared control opens profile, search, calendar selection, and creation; a grabber changes the relative height of the two panes.

name: Skyeng
uiSummary: A bright modular language-learning interface built on white space, saturated cyan actions, violet practice states, coral and green learning cards, and a mixed illustration system of soft 3D characters and flat educational scenes. Dense course variety stays approachable through rounded cards and a persistent five-tab shell.
uxSummary: Skyeng combines self-study, teacher products, AI lessons, speaking scenarios, vocabulary, homework, schedule, messages, courses, and settings.
navigationSummary: - Five bottom tabs lead to Home, Homework, Schedule, Messages, and Practice. - Vocabulary, course catalog, help, gifts, and profile open from contextual controls. - Practice groups daily assignments, AI teacher, situations, video, and audiobooks.
illustrationSummary: Skyeng combines soft 3D blue characters with bright flat educational scenes. Characters humanize AI speaking and onboarding, while flat art explains topics, situations, vocabulary, and course categories.

name: Ozon Bank
uiSummary: A bright banking system built around saturated blue account stages, white modular finance cards, soft cyan actions, pastel benefit notices, bold numeric type, and polished 3D product art.
uxSummary: Ozon Bank combines accounts, cards, cashback, transfers, payments, credit, savings, deposits, analytics, transaction history, chat, and product applications.
navigationSummary: Home, Payments, Benefits, Chats, and More are the primary destinations. Home begins with account access and quick money actions, followed by rewards, promotions, products, and recent operations.
illustrationSummary: Ozon Bank uses polished 3D cards, gifts, bubbles, arrows, ribbons, and ticket-like receipts to make products, cashback, credit, and payment results feel tangible.

name: Ozon Job
uiSummary: A bright operational mobile UI built from white rounded groups, pale gray page surfaces, and saturated Ozon blue actions. Dense workplace facts are broken into cards, chips, bottom sheets, and five persistent task tabs. Bold system-sans headings, concise monetary labels, documentary warehouse photography, and colorful 3D promotional scenes create a practical interface with energetic brand moments.
uxSummary: Ozon Job is a task-oriented worker app that connects shift discovery, warehouse details, bookings, payouts, training, and profile status. It favors visible operational facts and direct next actions over abstraction.
navigationSummary: Five persistent tabs cover Home, Bookings, Warehouses, Payments, and Courses. Profile and chat are available from the home header. Deeper paths use a back button, while booking and filter decisions often appear in bottom sheets.
illustrationSummary: Ozon Job mixes documentary workplace photography with bright 3D editorial graphics. The graphics explain promotions, safety, training, and progress while photography establishes real work environments.

name: WB Chat
uiSummary: A quiet monochrome messenger built from white space, charcoal actions, pale search fields, hairline-separated lists, rounded bottom docks, and restrained avatar color. Both light and dark themes keep the same low-decoration structure, letting conversation content provide identity.
uxSummary: WB Chat is a restrained messenger for contacts, private conversations, groups, channels, folders, and privacy settings.
navigationSummary: - A three-item primary navigation switches between Contacts, Chats, and Settings/Profile. - Chats can be filtered by All, Chats, Groups, and Channels before opening a thread. - Thread-level menus contain search, notifications, participant details, moderation, and destructive actions.

name: Trainline
uiSummary: A rail-booking interface that pairs a deep indigo journey header with mint and teal commitment actions, white rounded search panels, dense timetable rows, and playful service illustrations. Expressive discovery stays near the home and onboarding surfaces; booking, fare conditions, tickets, and payment become compact, explicit, and highly structured.
uxSummary: Trainline organizes international and local rail booking around a persistent search entry, legible timetable comparison, and a ticket area that remains useful before and after purchase.
navigationSummary: A three-item primary navigation anchors Search, My Tickets, and Account. Search opens a focused ticket form; purchase steps replace the bar with a single continuation action.
illustrationSummary: Trainline combines travel photography with a compact service-illustration system used for reassurance, education, and onboarding.

name: Omio
uiSummary: A multimodal travel marketplace built from navy headers, coral commitment actions, pale gray form rows, white comparison cards, and pastel blue-pink journey collages. Search remains welcoming and image-led, while transport results, hotel listings, passenger data, extras, and payment use a dense but calm operational grid.
uxSummary: Omio combines transport, stays, destination discovery, favorites, bookings, and profile utilities in one comparison-led travel shell.
navigationSummary: A five primary destinations anchors Search, Explore, Favorites, Bookings, and Profile. Search switches between Travel and Stays; focused selection and booking steps use a navy header with a clear back path.
illustrationSummary: Omio uses a recognizable pastel travel-collage language across splash, onboarding, home search, promotions, and payment progress.

name: Pool
uiSummary: A playful screenshot-organizer interface built on airy white space, fluid cyan controls, and tactile 3D brand objects. Editorial serif headings give the library character while a neutral system sans keeps actions legible. Screenshot mosaics are the primary content; frosted edge controls, rounded cards, and a yellow duck mascot create a soft, spatial layer above them.
uxSummary: Pool treats screenshot organization as a workspace: captured items land in one collection, can be opened in place, then grouped into named pools. The product keeps the collection visible and moves editing actions to contextual editing controls.
navigationSummary: Primary navigation switches between Home and Pools, while search and add remain available in that context. Settings opens from the account avatar. Detail views provide close, share, overflow, and item actions before returning to the originating list.
illustrationSummary: Pool combines tactile 3D symbols with a recurring yellow duck mascot. The illustration language makes a utilitarian screenshot library feel playful without competing with the user's own images.

name: Wabi
uiSummary: A playful AI-creator network alternating clean pearl-white workspaces with immersive black mini-app feeds. The interface is restrained and object-led: black pill controls, large rounded canvases, glassy 3D bubbles, sparse typography, and a five-item dock make generated experiences feel like collectible social objects.
uxSummary: Wabi combines a social feed, AI mini-app creation, personal collections, messaging, and profiles in one creator network.
navigationSummary: - A five primary destinations moves between Home, Search, Create, Messages, and Profile. - Home separates personal boards from the broader feed; mini-app actions stay attached to each creation. - Creation opens a conversational agent first, then exposes draft preview, settings, publishing, and board placement.
coreFlows: Discover and use a mini app
illustrationSummary: Wabi uses glossy 3D bubbles and translucent object capsules as its visual signature. Tiny photographs, avatars, tools, and surreal objects appear suspended inside glassy spheres.

name: KION
uiSummary: A black streaming interface driven by cinematic posters, white condensed-feeling headings, electric cyan links, a blue gradient subscription action, and a translucent dark tab bar. Content rails are dense and image-first; utility controls stay thin, outlined, and subordinate to media.
uxSummary: KION is a streaming hub for movies, series, TV, downloads, profiles, and subscription benefits, built around discovery and uninterrupted playback.
navigationSummary: Five primary destinations cover Home, TV, Movies, Series, and More. Search and filters remain available during discovery; detail pages preserve access to the primary navigation until playback starts.
